name: VR Game Night
summary:
Strap on your VR helmet and prepare for a hilarious, heart-pounding adventure! Dive into your first VR obstacle course, a bunch of challenges designed to test your agility, wit, and maybe even your dignity.

Gather your friends and be prepared for uproarious laughter as you try indoor sky diving, become a human foosball, and climb up slippery slopes. Don't worry about wiping out in real life – the only bruises here are virtual!

Once you've mastered the course, challenge your friends to an epic VR showdown.
